proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3674 kṣāra explicitly distinguishes widespread chār ashes from mostly khār alkali, including Jaunsari and western Pahari comparanda in the addendum. Selected car/char/tsar responses fit the ash family; aspiration, affricate/sibilant notation and final vowels remain qualified and unchanged. This does not equate every short ash word with kṣāra; local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: cʰaᵒr.
